financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales under the 2026 ATM Program, April 1 through May 8, 2026
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: Subsequent to the period ended March 31, 2026 through May 8, 2026 , the Company issued and sold 445,456 shares of common stock for net proceeds of $ 5.0 million under the 2026 ATM Program.

warrants.quote: The January 2025 Common Warrants have an exercise price of $ 7.80 per share, are immediately exercisable and will expire five years from the issuance date.
The June 2025 Warrant has an exercise price of $ 7.75 per share, is immediately exercisable, and expires five years from the date of issuance.
